description.value:
Juyo and Vaapad don't suppress the thrill of combat — they run on it, channeling raw emotion into heavy, sweeping strikes that hit like an avalanche. A guardian trained in this form fixes on a single target and hunts it with singular, almost predatory focus until it falls.

Where calmer forms treat passion as a liability, these duelists treat it as fuel, letting triumph and fury feed each subsequent exchange, growing more dangerous the longer a fight drags on.
